name: demo-script
description: Prepare a reproducible 60-second VenturaBio demo that proves one implemented computational analysis on a traceable dataset. Use when an executable MVP slice needs a concise demonstration. Do not use when the analysis is unimplemented or the demo would imply clinical validation.

# Demo script

- Use one small public or synthetic dataset with recorded provenance.
- Show the input command or API call and resulting computational artifact.
- State organism data type and method assumptions when relevant.
- Include one scientific or computational limitation.
- Do not present the output as laboratory or clinical validation.
- Verify the workflow from a clean checkout before publishing.
